items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: The cat is going to be obliged to play another tune.

ctx.x: The cat is going to be obliged to play another tune. Until the guy who is booking it says, "All right, that's enough out there. If they're coming, they're coming." Then someone says, "They ain't comin', they ain't comin'." "Come on in here, let's get this band going." Because the people inside would be waiting...
